content:
In Switzerland, part-time employees are insured against non-occupational accidents (accidents outside of working hours) if their weekly working time meets a certain threshold. The legal requirement is that part-time employees must work at least **12 hours per week** for their employer to be covered under the non-occupational accident insurance scheme.

This rule is governed by Swiss social security law and ensures that part-time workers have protection against accidents occurring during their leisure time, in the same way as full-time employees.
